text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Ooh...! The shark! Still huge today! Looks 
so tough!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
All right, into a drawing that captures 
just how amazing this is...!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Whoosh! Rawr! How many more drawings do I 
need to make a shark video~?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Ah, a LANE notification from Trainer... 
Time for training, huh.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
—Sharks don't sweat the small stuff! 
Brrrrrap!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Twin Turbo kept right on drawing and 
completely skipped her training...
